items.title: Artist's Book Residency Grant
items.funding:
Fund: partial
Application fee: free
Programme fee: none
Travel: you pay (up to $250 covered for Continental US only)
Stay: covered
Living: covered ($350/week stipend)
You pay in total: international travel (not stated)
items.eligibility: Visual artists producing artist's books; open to women, trans, intersex, non-binary, gender-fluid artists worldwide; any career stage; IELTS not required; NET not required; language English; age not stated
items.verifyNote: Confirmed on official WSW page 6 Nov 2026; applications open, deadline 15 Nov 2026 23:59 EST

items.title: Jan van Eyck Academie Residency 2028
items.funding:
Fund: partial
Application fee: €65 (excl. VAT) or free for DAC list countries (India lower-middle)
Programme fee: €2750 (excl. VAT)
Travel: you pay
Stay: covered (private studio apartment, rent may be deducted from stipend)
Living: covered (€1500/month stipend)
You pay in total: application fee + programme fee + travel (not fully stated)
items.eligibility: Artists, curators, designers, writers, architects, artistic researchers; BFA/MFA equivalent preferred but not strictly required; open worldwide; IELTS not stated; NET not required; language English; age not stated
items.verifyNote: Confirmed via official announcements and Res Artis; open until 1 Dec 2026

items.title: Sixi International Artist-in-Residence Project 2027 Spring & Autumn
items.funding:
Fund: partial
Application fee: free
Programme fee: none
Travel: covered (round-trip flights)
Stay: covered (private apartment or loft studio)
Living: you pay (material allowance provided; no daily stipend stated)
You pay in total: living expenses (not stated)
items.eligibility: Artists of all disciplines including visual arts/painting/sculpture; open worldwide no nationality restriction; 18+ at application; sufficient spoken/written English or Mandarin; IELTS not required; NET not required; language English or Mandarin; age 18+
items.verifyNote: Confirmed on official Sixi Museum residency page and Res Artis open call 7 Nov 2026; deadline 15 Nov 2026 GMT+8; covers visa fees, round-trip flights, insurance, stay, materials; living costs by artist

items.title: DRS Arts Grant 2027
items.funding:
Fund: fully funded
Application fee: free
Programme fee: none
Travel: not applicable
Stay: not applicable
Living: not applicable
You pay in total: none
items.eligibility: Indian citizens currently based in India; practising visual artists any medium (painting, sculpture etc.), formally trained, independently trained or self-taught; age 18+ on closing date (categories: 18-24 ₹60000, 25-29 ₹60000, 30+ ₹240000, under 30 award ₹30000); IELTS not required; NET not required; language English, Hindi, Gujarati or any Indian language; age 18+
items.verifyNote: Confirmed on official drsartsgrant.com how-to-apply page 7 Nov 2026; applications open 3-23 Nov 2026; free to apply; cash grants for visual artists in India
